Markets.title: HDFC Bank submits two candidates to RBI for next CEO
Markets.summary: HDFC Bank has submitted the names of two candidates to the Reserve Bank of India to succeed its current leader. The individuals have been proposed for the position of managing director and chief executive officer of the private lender.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Weak technical setup to keep bulls under pressure
Markets.summary: The Indian stock market's technical structure has weakened after the Nifty broke below its critical 23,900–24,000 support zone. Additionally, the index has fallen below both its 50-week and 100-week moving averages, leaving bulls under pressure.

Markets.title: Explained: What Sebi’s proposed CAS changes mean for expiry-day trading and settlement
Markets.summary: Markets regulator SEBI has proposed two options to determine expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives. The proposals also include changes to trading session timings and additional measures to improve the auction process.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty has slipped below its crucial support, says Sudeep Shah; picks 5 stocks for next week
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices recovered from deeper intraday dips to end with modest declines as easing oil prices and bond yields helped offset geopolitical pressures. Analyst Sudeep Shah notes that the Nifty has slipped below its crucial support level and recommends maintaining caution while picking five stocks for the coming week.

Markets.title: Bitcoin trades at $77,000 mark as profit-taking weighs on market; September FOMC meeting to act as next catalyst
Markets.summary: Bitcoin is trading near $77,000 following a slight retreat from $78,000 due to profit-taking. Investors are now closely watching the upcoming September FOMC meeting as the next major market catalyst.

Markets.title: Demat 2.0 explained: Why it matters for bond market investors
Markets.summary: SEBI has launched a pilot scheme called Demat 2.0 to tokenise corporate bonds for faster settlements and instant fund retrieval. The initiative uses smart contracts to automate payments and mitigate settlement risks for investors.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
Geo-Political.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is urging the artificial intelligence industry to slow down its development pace. He made this request because of increasing worries that advanced AI models could cause widespread global damage.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia shut down a key oil pipeline following a drone attack launched from an Iraqi border region near Iran. Iraq has since removed a military commander and launched an investigation into the incident.

Geo-Political.title: A united Ireland would be 'fantastic' says Trump during Irish visit
Geo-Political.summary: During a visit to Ireland, Donald Trump told Irish leader Micheál Martin that a united Ireland would be fantastic. In response to the comments, Downing Street stated that it remains committed to the Good Friday Agreement.

Geo-Political.title: French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment
Geo-Political.summary: French officials are investigating whether a malicious act caused a passenger train derailment on Friday that injured 44 people. Investigators discovered a rail fragment on the tracks following the crash.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: A senior UN official warns that Ukraine faces its most difficult winter yet regarding power and water access since the Russian invasion began. Organizations are currently in a race against time to secure these essential services before the cold weather sets in.

Geo-Political.title: Uganda's King Oyo buried amid calls for unity over his successor
Geo-Political.summary: Following the burial of Uganda's King Oyo, a TV news presenter was named as the new monarch of the Tooro kingdom. However, the late king's family disputed this, claiming the late monarch had chosen a different heir.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic acquisition compared to traditional search engine optimization (SEO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and streamline their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for content creation. The platform allows users to generate, share, and monetize their AI-created content.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Air India’s new CEO, IPO wave, oil above $100
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-based insights and charts covering Mint's top stories, including Air India's new CEO, an IPO wave, and oil prices exceeding $100. It provides readers with an analytical overview of major economic and corporate developments from the past week.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi urges BRICS to turn its growing economic weight into stronger trade, investment and business partnerships
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS nations to reduce trade barriers, deepen investments, and secure sea lanes to strengthen their economic partnerships. He also presented India's infrastructure, startups, and digital public infrastructure as key drivers for global growth.

Data & Insights.title: Modi meets Pezeshkian amid US-Iran War: Seafarers’ safety in West Asia, BRICS cooperation discussed
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi. The two leaders discussed strengthening bilateral ties, multilateral cooperation, and the safety of seafarers in West Asia amidst regional conflict.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund stated that India's real GDP grew by 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, exceeding expectations. The IMF also praised improvements in data transparency and GDP estimation revisions as India continues to serve as a major global growth engine despite energy price shocks.

Data & Insights.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Putin proposed a BRICS digital investment platform via the New Development Bank during a meeting in New Delhi to attract private funding and boost competitiveness. He also stated that the bloc's economic growth is now outpacing the G7 nations.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: From trade to defence, energy and space - What transpired during Modi-Putin meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin met at the BRICS Summit to review bilateral cooperation. According to the Ministry of External Affairs, their discussions covered progress in trade, defence, energy, space, and people-to-people relations.

India.title: Iranian President's Daughter Visits PM Museum, BRICS Bazaar In Delhi
India.summary: The daughter of the Iranian president visited the Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya (PM Museum) and the BRICS Bazaar in New Delhi. Her tour highlighted cultural and international engagement during her visit to India.

India.title: Ladakh Lt Governor Rejects Protected Area Report Over Legal, Security Concerns
India.summary: Ladakh's Lieutenant Governor has rejected a report proposing a Protected Area Permit for certain regions. The decision was made due to ongoing legal and security concerns.

India.title: Manoj Jarange To March To Mumbai, Begin Hunger Strike On September 19
India.summary: Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange announced plans to lead a protest march covering about 100 kilometers daily to Mumbai. He will begin an indefinite hunger strike at Azad Maidan on September 19.

India.title: Out For Jogging, Techie Dies After Being Hit By Car In Pune
India.summary: A techie died after being struck by a car while out for a morning jog in Pune. Police stated that the vehicle involved in the accident was registered to a private company.

India.title: Amit Shah's Mumbai Visit Spans Hindi Conference, Lalbaugcha Raja Darshan
India.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah arrived in Mumbai on Saturday night for a visit that includes attending a Hindi conference and visiting the Lalbaugcha Raja pandal. He was also expected to meet with Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and other BJP leaders late Saturday night to discuss organizational matters.

India.title: Former Air India Pilot Found Dead At 5-Star Hotel In Delhi's Vasant Kunj
India.summary: A former Air India flight captain was found dead inside a five-star hotel in Delhi's Vasant Kunj area. Police reported that the man was discovered unconscious and unresponsive at Hotel The Grand.

General.title: Reform receives second £36m donation in two days as crypto investor matches record
General.summary: Reform UK received a second £36 million donation from a crypto investor within two days. Rival parties responded by renewing calls for a cap on individual political donations.

General.title: Burnham and Badenoch revive red versus blue politics as Reform land 'gobsmacking' donations
General.summary: Andy Burnham and Kemi Badenoch are reviving traditional Labour and Conservative political divisions as Reform UK experiences a drop in the polls. Meanwhile, Reform UK has recently received significant financial donations described as gobsmacking.

General.title: Trump says united Ireland would be 'fantastic' during visit to Dublin
General.summary: During a visit to Dublin, Donald Trump told Irish leader Micheál Martin that a united Ireland would be "fantastic." In response, Downing Street stated that it would "stick to the Good Friday Agreement."

General.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
General.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is urging the artificial intelligence industry to slow down its development pace. He made this call due to rising concerns that advanced AI models could eventually cause severe global harm.

General.title: Oscar-winning film producer Jeremy Thomas dies aged 77
General.summary: Oscar-winning British film producer Jeremy Thomas has died at the age of 77. Throughout his decades-long career, he was best known for producing acclaimed films such as The Last Emperor and Sexy Beast.

General.title: Three arrests at Portsmouth protests including man, 76, suspected of concealing identity
General.summary: Police arrested three people, including a 76-year-old man suspected of concealing his identity, during rival protests in Portsmouth. The demonstrations occurred as new police powers came into force in the area.
